title: PostScript signature (%!PS)
summary: A PostScript file begins with the 2-byte signature %! followed by an optional 'PS' and version (e.g. %!PS-Adobe-3.0).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: EPS (Encapsulated PostScript) adds '%%BoundingBox:' and is often wrapped in a 32-byte DOS EPS binary header.
PostScript is a Turing-complete page description language.
